decisions.reason: Its closeness to the firm's compliance knowledge allows it to interpret the early positive feedback and improve the software through in-house R&D.
As the flagship platform built directly on the firm's core infrastructure and tooling, it has high absorptive capacity and remains central to the firm's direction.
The configurable managed hosting plan is close to the existing hosting offer, so the firm can readily assimilate early usage data and apply its internal R&D to refine it.
Extended PHP security support leverages the firm's existing security and hosting expertise, giving it the absorptive capacity to learn from early adoption and continue improving the product.
